# Zhara

> Zhara is an AI Discovery & Search app for Shopify stores. It replaces default storefront search with intent-aware search that understands typos, synonyms, and natural-language queries, and ties every search to revenue.

Zhara combines fast keyword search (typo-tolerant, ~50ms responses) with semantic AI search as a fallback, so shoppers find products even when their words don't match the catalog. Merchants keep full control with merchandising rules and see exactly how search converts to sales.

## What Zhara does

- Intent-aware search: understands typos, regional synonyms (e.g. "chaddi" → boxers), and natural-language queries like "something warm for winter"
- Instant results: typo-tolerant keyword search in ~50ms, with semantic AI fallback when keywords miss
- Merchant controls: pin, bury, hide, or redirect any product for any query — merchandising rules stay in the merchant's hands
- Zero-state and recommendations: helpful results even for empty or failed searches
- Search-to-sale analytics: a full search → click → add-to-cart → purchase funnel with revenue attribution per query

## Who it's for

Shopify merchants who want storefront search that converts — especially stores with large catalogs, diverse customer vocabulary, or international shoppers.
